Kimberly —

Thanks for the doc. Quick read-through this morning, looks good and much clearer than our internal templates. I shared with Bob and our engineering lead (cc'd on our side). A few initial notes:

- Latency row: can we make the baseline explicit (p95 at 500 tokens)? Our infra team needs that number to evaluate impact.
- Security row: we need a short sub-bullet about data retention (30 days) and whether logs include raw prompts — can you confirm?
- Timeline: week 2 has an integration milestone; our SREs prefer to push that to week 3 due to resource constraints.

We'll add comments directly in the gdoc by Thursday. If you can respond to the two bullets above, I'll route to procurement for a quick review.

Best,

Thanks Alice — quick replies inline and I'll update the doc: 

- Latency baseline: we can commit p95 <= 350ms for a 500-token-ish typical prompt on the dedicated pilot instance. I'll add a clear table row with the measurement method (synthetic runner + 1000 sample requests).
- Data retention/logs: by default Redwood stores request metadata and token counts; raw prompts are not retained in long-term logs unless you opt in. For this pilot we can set a 30-day raw prompt retention window and enable redact-by-default for sensitive fields. I'll add the short sub-bullet you requested and note KMS/HSM for key management.
- Timeline: moving the infra integration to week 3 is fine — I adjusted the week-by-week milestones in the sheet.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll push an updated MAP doc and the acceptance spreadsheet by noon PT today.
2) Alice / Bob, please add comments on acceptance criteria by Thu EOD.
3) We’ll schedule a 30-min alignment on Mon 14 Jun to confirm pilot start and ask for any procurement documents needed.

Quick note on procurement: if procurement wants an SOW or basic T&Cs, loop in Marissa (cc'd) — she can support a standard pilot addendum and 30-day invoice terms.

Link to updated doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdEfGhIJk-example-map

Cheers,
Kimberly
